About.heading: A shop that loves cotton
About.body1: YinPhone started in 2019 from a tiny stall near Bogyoke Market. The idea was simple: light cotton pieces that suit Yangon weather, at fair prices.
About.body2: Today we deliver to customers across the country through photo orders on Messenger, Viber and Telegram. Every piece is checked by hand in the shop and packed with care.
About.ctaHint: Head to the catalog for the newest arrivals

Contact.address: No.24, Bogyoke Market Rd, Pabedan Township, Yangon

items.question: Which areas do you deliver to?
items.answer: Cash on delivery inside Yangon; other townships go by Royal Express / Ninja Van within 2–4 days.

items.question: Can I exchange an item?
items.answer: Yes, within 7 days if the size is wrong. The piece must be unworn with its tag still on.

items.question: Which payment methods?
items.answer: KPay, WavePay and AYA Pay, plus cash on delivery inside Yangon.
